Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted information provided by the WebSurfer and concluded that Mel Gibson attended the University of New South Wales (UNSW) when the correct information is that he studied at the National Institute of Dramatic Art (NIDA). The Planner failed to recognize that NIDA, although located on the UNSW campus, is a separate institution. This error mirrors the pattern of misinterpretation and premature conclusion based on partially correct information, similar to the errors outlined in the schema examples.
